sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chains to autonomous systems that can plan, use tools, and execute multi-step workflows. Highlighted real production use cases where agents reduced manual developer work by 60%.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on building reliable AI infrastructure for developers, emphasizing the need for better observability, testing frameworks, and cost controls when deploying LLM-powered tools at scale.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction & AI investor
sources.post_summary: Posted about the next wave of AI automation tools that are moving beyond chat interfaces into deeply integrated developer environments, including new open-source projects for agent orchestration.

sources.author: Matt Rickard
sources.headline: Founder @ Replicate & AI infrastructure builder
sources.post_summary: Explained how new AI agent frameworks are shifting the bottleneck from model quality to infrastructure reliability, sharing benchmarks on latency and uptime for production agent deployments.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Notion | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that treats outbound as a product: defining ICP signals, building enrichment pipelines, and measuring conversion at each stage. Shared how her team reduced manual SDR work by 60% using custom scoring models.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Explained how his RevOps team integrated intent data with CRM workflows to trigger personalized outbound sequences. Highlighted a 3x increase in meeting book rates after implementing automated lead scoring and dynamic content insertion.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Content Strategy Lead @ HubSpot | B2B SaaS
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for aligning content with outbound motions: mapping buyer journey stages to specific content assets and using engagement data to prioritize follow-ups. Noted a 40% lift in pipeline contribution from content-assisted outreach.

sources.author: David Kline
sources.headline: Founder @ OutboundOS | GTM Systems
sources.post_summary: Detailed building an outbound automation stack using APIs and no-code tools to sync signals from multiple data sources into sequenced campaigns. Emphasized the importance of clean data architecture for sustainable scale.

sources.author: Sofia Patel
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Posted about redesigning the revenue operating system to include GTM engineering principles: defining SLAs between marketing, sales, and CS with automated handoff triggers. Shared metrics showing reduced CAC payback period.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at PostHog
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey of building and shipping PostHog's new feature in public over 4 weeks, including weekly updates on user feedback, technical challenges, and how transparency helped attract early adopters and collaborators.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder at Nomad List & Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Posted about launching a new micro-SaaS in 5 days as a solo founder, sharing revenue numbers, tech stack decisions, and lessons on validating ideas quickly without a team.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Software Engineer | Career Switcher
sources.post_summary: Detailed his transition from marketing to software engineering after a 9-month self-taught journey, including how he built 3 portfolio projects in public and landed his first dev role at a startup.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Founder, Author & Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Wrote about bootstrapping and publicly documenting the development of his latest product, including weekly progress threads on user interviews, pricing experiments, and the emotional side of solo building.

sources.author: Sasha Sadilova
sources.headline: Software Engineer | Ex-Marketing
sources.post_summary: Shared her story of pivoting from digital marketing to full-stack development, highlighting the open-source contributions and side projects she shipped publicly that helped her get interviews.
